integrity: Exact rational counterexample and exhaustive four-event check; universal assertion proved by exchange inequalities, not by finite test.
scientific_limitations: Ideal initially dry one-store impulse model. Equal positive interstorm retention, immediate capacity spill, three-pulse theorem and a specific four-pulse counterexample; no general four-pulse optimizer or field calibration. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains uncertain.
title: The largest-storm-first rule holds through three pulses but fails at four
